headerDisplay: Please see the [installation guide](https://github.com/stringbean/homebridge-drayton-wiser/wiki/Installation) for instructions on how to obtain the secret from your HeatHub.

namePrefix.title: Discovery hostname prefix
namePrefix.description: Only change this if your router overrides the name of your HeatHub

overrideAddress.title: Manual HeatHub Address
overrideAddress.description: Use this option if your HeatHub cannot be automatically discovered

hideAwayButton.title: Hide 'Away' button
hideAwayButton.description: Hides switch that enables 'Away' mode for your Wiser system

hideBoostSwitches.title: Hide room 'Boost' switches
hideBoostSwitches.description: Hides the switch on each room that boosts its heating for a limited time

boostDuration.title: Boost duration (minutes)
boostDuration.description: How long a room boost lasts before returning to its schedule

boostTemperature.title: Boost temperature increase (°C)
boostTemperature.description: How much to raise the room temperature by when boosting
